name: Hotel Madhuban
why_it_matters: Trimbakeshwar's pilgrim-thali institution on Temple Road, 300m from the Jyotirlinga gate — Maharashtrian satvik thali (no onion-garlic by default), bhakri + pithla + zunka + rice + dal + sweet. Sabudana khichdi for Sinhastha Kumbh + Shravan-Monday vrat days.
insider_tip: Mahashivratri (Feb-Mar) + Shravan Mondays (Jul-Aug) + Sinhastha Kumbh windows the queue starts 11am — arrive 10.30 or after 2.30pm. Modak Aug-Sep Ganesh Chaturthi season. Cash + UPI.

name: MTDC Trimbakeshwar Restaurant
why_it_matters: MTDC Brahmagiri's in-house dining 1.5km from Trimbakeshwar temple on the Brahmagiri-trailhead side — pure-veg Maharashtrian + Punjabi-influenced multi-cuisine for the government-rate pilgrim stay base. Walk-in non-residents welcome 12.30-3pm + 7.30-10pm. The only AC-dining option on the Brahmagiri-side.
insider_tip: Mahashivratri + Sinhastha Kumbh windows fill the dining hall — book +91-2594-233217 ahead. Cards + UPI work; cash preferred.
signature_address: MTDC Brahmagiri, near Brahmagiri trailhead, Trimbakeshwar 422212

name: Sai Bhojanalay
why_it_matters: Trimbak bus-stand pilgrim thali kitchen — the bus-arriving + budget pilgrim default. Satvik thali at ₹120 with bhakri + pithla + dal + 1 vegetable + rice + sweet + buttermilk.
insider_tip: Pre-darshan breakfast 6-9am quietest (the bus-pilgrim wave fills 9-11am). Sabudana khichdi served Mon + Thu lunch (vrat days). Filter coffee refill free with thali. Cash + UPI; no cards.

name: Annapurna Veg
why_it_matters: Temple Road pilgrim multi-cuisine 200m from the Jyotirlinga gate — Maharashtrian thali + South-Indian breakfast tiffin (idli-dosa-vada) for the multi-state pilgrim base. The South-Indian pilgrim wave (Andhra/Karnataka/Tamil Nadu Jyotirlinga circuit) drives the dosa demand.
insider_tip: South-Indian tiffin 6-10am breakfast; Maharashtrian thali 11.30-3.30pm + 7-10.30pm. Free filter-coffee refill with thali. Cash + UPI; no cards.
signature_address: Temple Road, near Trimbak Bus Stand, Trimbakeshwar 422212
